subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session:aborted + opt-in auto-continue hook

question: Should OpenClaw ship an opt-in bundled auto-continue hook that starts up to three fresh turns after watchdog aborts and formalize `defaultEnableMode` as source-policy-governed hook metadata?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and the submitted live proof is credible, but deciding whether automatic post-abort retries belong in the bundled hook set is a product and operational-policy choice rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Accept the scoped opt-in design
options.body: Keep the hook disabled by default, retain the per-session budget and source-policy guard, and merge after normal owner validation.

options.title: Keep the event, externalize the policy
options.body: Merge or retain only the generic abort event and ask contributors to provide auto-resume behavior through an external hook or plugin instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped opt-in design
recommendation.body: Keep the hook disabled by default, retain the per-session budget and source-policy guard, and merge after normal owner validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged hook-policy work and detailed review establish the strongest available adjacent ownership signal.
